surfactants.class: not a cleansing route (sorbitan ester emulsifier/preservation booster; no C3 cleansing class)

wLine.derivation: Earliest candidate Panthenol@11 (class c): (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) between 11 and the cap 14 only Tetrasodium Glutamate Diacetate and Sodium Benzoate -> plausible. No earlier candidate (Sorbitan Caprylate is not on the booster list). Longest ascending run is 6 entries, so no alphabetical run.

cleansingStrength.rationale: moderate by C1: the defining anionic is Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 (ether type), buffered by two prominent buffers (Coco-Glucoside@3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine@4) with no reinforcing strong anionic - the settled ether-sulfate-plus-buffer core.

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful conditioning system - cationic guar (Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@9) with a prominent waxy payload lipid (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil@7) - plus light routes (Glyceryl Oleate@8, Panthenol@11). C2 is not met: the payload lipid can take the place of the silicone, but no separate pearlizing/fatty route (no glycol distearate, no fatty alcohol) is present. Counter-signal: if Glyceryl Oleate@8 were read as the fatty route, C2 would be met and support high; neighbor high.

weightPotential.rationale: moderate: W-RICH is established (material waxy Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil@7, before the W-line Panthenol@11, converging with cationic guar@9), but reset is not limited - the C1 SLES/glucoside/betaine chassis gives moderate reset - so the rich route does not reach high; the other high route (multiple converging persistent systems not offset by reset) is not convincingly met with one guar, one lipid and a weak refatter. W-RICH is recorded as the counter-signal and high as the neighbor.

reset: Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 (strong anionic, ether type)
excluded: Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil@16, Citrus Limon Peel Oil@17 (fragrance oils, 6.4)

weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH holds: a hydrogenated/waxy lipid is more substantive than a liquid oil and it sits early (7), directly next to the cationic guar (9).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A plausibly persistent deposit (waxy lipid + cationic guar + glyceryl oleate) makes calling it lightweight an understatement, while an effective ordinary sulfate chassis with two buffers bounds the residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs W-RICH plus limited (weak) reset, or multiple converging persistent systems that reset does not offset; reset here is moderate and the deposition is one guar plus one lipid, without silicone or film formers.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH is present and the balance between a waxy lipid deposit and moderate reset is an expert judgment; realistic unknowns (lipid level) could move it to high.
